title: Chiral Perturbation to One Loop Including the rho Meson
note: PDF library/arxiv-hep-ph-9306237v1/ — arXiv:hep-ph/9306237v1, stamped 7 Jun 1993; report numbers KEK-TH-349 and KEK preprint 92-169, dated April 1993 on page 1. One-loop ChPT with the rho as a hidden-local-symmetry gauge boson; the abstract states matching conditions 'to the conventional chiral perturbation of Gasser and Leutwyler in the chiral limit in a renormalization scale independent manner'.
